mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, name, sort
mapper.select: select spec_prefix from sys_assemble_spec where bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT ac.id, ac.name, ac.sort FROM sys_assemble_config AS ac WHERE ac.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND ac.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
AND ac.mes_product_enum = #{mesProductEnum}
ORDER BY ac.sort, ac.id

SELECT ac.id, ac.name, ac.sort, ac.bool_section_steel, sas.spec_prefix, sas.spec_index, scl.classify_name, scl.classify_id, scl.path FROM sys_assemble_config AS ac LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_spec AS sas ON ac.id = sas.assemble_config_id LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_classify_link scl on scl.assemble_config_id = ac.id AND sas.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE ac.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND ac.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
AND sas.spec_prefix like concat('%',#{specPrefix},'%')
AND ac.mes_product_enum = #{mesProductEnum}
ORDER BY ac.sort,ac.id

SELECT config.id 'steelId', config.`name` 'steelName', link.classify_id, link.classify_name, 2 'basicClassId' FROM sys_assemble_config config LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_classify_link link ON config.id = link.assemble_config_id AND link.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE config.bool_delete_enum =0 -- AND config.bool_section_steel =1

SELECT steel.id steel_id, steel.`name` steel_name, steel. basic_class AS basicClassId, link.classify_id classify_id, link.classify_name classify_name FROM sys_steel_classification steel LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classify_link link ON steel.id = link.steel_id AND link.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE steel.bool_delete_enum = 0 and steel.basic_class = 2
